folder.description: Folder name or ID (e.g., inbox, drafts, sentitems, archive)

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to return (default: 10, max: 50)

filter.description: OData filter query (e.g., isRead eq false or from/emailAddress/address eq 'exec@corp.com')

search.description: KQL search keyword across subject, body, or sender

tools.name: get_message
tools.description: Retrieves complete message content, HTML body, internet headers, and recipient arrays (GET /me/messages/{id}).

messageId.description: The unique Microsoft Graph ID of the message

tools.name: search_messages
tools.description: Executes full-text keyword search across email subjects, sender addresses, and body text.

query.description: Search term or keyword to search for

tools.name: send_mail
tools.description: Sends a new email message to recipients (POST /me/sendMail).

body.description: Email body text or HTML content

tools.name: create_draft
tools.description: Composes a new draft message in the Drafts folder without sending (POST /me/messages).

tools.name: update_draft
tools.description: Modifies subject, body, or recipients of an existing unsent draft message (PATCH /me/messages/{id}).

messageId.description: The draft message ID to update

tools.name: send_draft
tools.description: Dispatches an existing draft message to its specified recipients (POST /me/messages/{id}/send).

messageId.description: The draft message ID to send

tools.name: reply_mail
tools.description: Sends a reply message to the original sender of an email (POST /me/messages/{id}/reply).

messageId.description: The message ID being replied to

tools.name: reply_all_mail
tools.description: Sends a reply to all recipients and the sender of an email thread (POST /me/messages/{id}/replyAll).

messageId.description: The message ID being replied to

comment.description: Reply text message to send to all recipients

tools.name: forward_mail
tools.description: Forwards an email to specified recipients with optional forwarding commentary (POST /me/messages/{id}/forward).

messageId.description: The message ID to forward

to.description: Recipient email addresses to forward to

tools.name: delete_message
tools.description: Permanently deletes an email message or moves it to Deleted Items (DELETE /me/messages/{id}).

messageId.description: The message ID to delete

tools.name: move_message
tools.description: Moves an email message to a specified destination mail folder (POST /me/messages/{id}/move).

messageId.description: The message ID to move

destinationId.description: Destination folder ID or well-known name (e.g., archive, junkemail)

tools.name: copy_message
tools.description: Copies an email message to a specified destination mail folder without removing it from original location (POST /me/messages/{id}/copy).

messageId.description: The message ID to copy

destinationId.description: Destination folder ID or well-known name (e.g., archive, processed)

tools.name: mark_as_read
tools.description: Marks an email message as read in the user mailbox, clearing the unread badge (PATCH /me/messages/{id} with isRead: true).

messageId.description: The unique Microsoft Graph ID of the message to mark as read

isRead.description: True to mark as read (default: true)

tools.name: mark_as_unread
tools.description: Marks an email message as unread in the user mailbox (PATCH /me/messages/{id} with isRead: false).

messageId.description: The unique Microsoft Graph ID of the message to mark as unread

tools.name: update_message
tools.description: Updates message properties such as read status, categories, importance, or subject (PATCH /me/messages/{id}).

messageId.description: The unique Microsoft Graph ID of the message

tools.name: flag_message
tools.description: Sets a follow-up flag on an email message with optional due date (PATCH /me/messages/{id}).

messageId.description: The message ID to flag

dueDateTime.description: Optional follow-up due date ISO string

tools.name: complete_message_flag
tools.description: Marks an email follow-up flag as completed (PATCH /me/messages/{id} with flagStatus: complete).

messageId.description: The message ID whose flag to complete

tools.name: set_message_categories
tools.description: Assigns Outlook master color categories to an email for visual tagging and triage (PATCH /me/messages/{id}).

messageId.description: The message ID to categorize

tools.name: get_mime_content
tools.description: Retrieves the complete raw RFC822 MIME byte stream (.eml format) for forensic auditing or compliance archive (GET /me/messages/{id}/$value).

messageId.description: The message ID to export in MIME format

tools.name: list_mail_folders
tools.description: Lists all mail folders in the user mailbox (GET /me/mailFolders).

includeHidden.description: Whether to include system or hidden folders

tools.name: create_mail_folder
tools.description: Creates a new mail folder under root or a parent folder (POST /me/mailFolders).

parentFolderId.description: Optional parent folder ID to create subfolder under

tools.name: get_mail_folder
tools.description: Retrieves folder details including total item count and unread count (GET /me/mailFolders/{id}).

folderId.description: Folder ID or well-known name (e.g. inbox, archive, drafts)

tools.name: update_mail_folder
tools.description: Renames an existing mail folder (PATCH /me/mailFolders/{id}).

displayName.description: New display name for the folder

tools.name: delete_mail_folder
tools.description: Permanently deletes a custom mail folder and its contents (DELETE /me/mailFolders/{id}).

tools.name: list_message_attachments
tools.description: Retrieves all attachments (files, embedded items, and cloud reference links) with metadata for a message (GET /me/messages/{id}/attachments).

messageId.description: The message ID to fetch attachments from

tools.name: read_attachment_content

tools.description: Schedules a calendar event with attendees, agenda, and optional online Teams meeting (POST /me/events).

tools.description: Modifies timing, attendees, location, or agenda of an existing event (PATCH /me/events/{id}).

tools.description: Tentatively accepts a calendar meeting invitation (POST /me/events/{id}/tentativelyAccept).

tools.description: Checks free/busy availability of requested attendees and suggests optimal meeting slots (POST /me/findMeetingTimes).

messageId.description: The unique Microsoft Graph ID of the message

tools.name: flag_message
tools.description: Sets a follow-up flag on an email message with optional due date (PATCH /me/messages/{id}).

messageId.description: The message ID to flag

dueDateTime.description: Optional follow-up due date ISO string

tools.name: complete_message_flag
tools.description: Marks an email follow-up flag as completed (PATCH /me/messages/{id} with flagStatus: complete).

messageId.description: The message ID whose flag to complete

tools.name: set_message_categories
tools.description: Assigns Outlook master color categories to an email for visual tagging and triage (PATCH /me/messages/{id}).

messageId.description: The message ID to categorize

tools.name: get_mime_content
tools.description: Retrieves the complete raw RFC822 MIME byte stream (.eml format) for forensic auditing or compliance archive (GET /me/messages/{id}/$value).

messageId.description: The message ID to export in MIME format

tools.name: list_mail_folders
tools.description: Lists all mail folders in the user mailbox (GET /me/mailFolders).

includeHidden.description: Whether to include system or hidden folders

tools.name: create_mail_folder
tools.description: Creates a new mail folder under root or a parent folder (POST /me/mailFolders).

parentFolderId.description: Optional parent folder ID to create subfolder under

tools.name: get_mail_folder
tools.description: Retrieves folder details including total item count and unread count (GET /me/mailFolders/{id}).

folderId.description: Folder ID or well-known name (e.g. inbox, archive, drafts)

tools.name: update_mail_folder
tools.description: Renames an existing mail folder (PATCH /me/mailFolders/{id}).

displayName.description: New display name for the folder

tools.name: delete_mail_folder
tools.description: Permanently deletes a custom mail folder and its contents (DELETE /me/mailFolders/{id}).

tools.name: list_message_attachments
tools.description: Retrieves all attachments (files, embedded items, and cloud reference links) with metadata for a message (GET /me/messages/{id}/attachments).

messageId.description: The message ID to fetch attachments from

tools.name: read_attachment_content
tools.description: Downloads, decodes, and security-sanitizes file attachment content into clean text, tabular data, or structured JSON with SHA-256 fingerprinting (GET /me/messages/{id}/attachments/{id}).

messageId.description: The message ID containing the attachment

attachmentId.description: Optional specific attachment ID (or reads first file attachment if omitted)

tools.name: read_item_attachment
tools.description: Unpacks nested Outlook items (e.g. attached .eml email threads, .ics calendar invitations, or .vcf contacts) with full subject, sender, and body content.

messageId.description: The outer message ID containing the item attachment

tools.name: get_reference_attachment
tools.description: Inspects cloud reference attachments linked to OneDrive or SharePoint files, retrieving source URLs, permissions, and file metadata.

messageId.description: The message ID containing the reference attachment

tools.name: download_attachment_raw
tools.description: Streams the raw binary content directly from Microsoft Graph (GET /me/messages/{id}/attachments/{id}/$value) without Base64 overhead.

messageId.description: The message ID containing the attachment

tools.name: add_message_attachment
tools.description: Attaches a file to a draft message (POST /me/messages/{id}/attachments). Supports inline attachments with contentId.

messageId.description: The draft message ID

contentType.description: MIME type of the file (e.g., application/pdf)

isInline.description: Whether the attachment is rendered inline in the email body

contentId.description: Optional Content-ID header for inline referencing (cid:)

tools.name: upload_large_attachment
tools.description: Uploads large files (up to 150 MB) using a chunked resumable upload session (POST /me/messages/{id}/attachments/createUploadSession).

messageId.description: The draft message ID

contentBytes.description: Base64-encoded full file content to chunk-upload

tools.name: delete_attachment
tools.description: Permanently deletes an attachment from a draft email message (DELETE /me/messages/{id}/attachments/{id}).

messageId.description: The draft message ID

tools.name: list_event_attachments
tools.description: Lists all attachments linked to a calendar meeting or event (GET /me/events/{id}/attachments).

tools.name: add_event_attachment
tools.description: Attaches a document or agenda file to a calendar event (POST /me/events/{id}/attachments).

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: Lists upcoming calendar events from the default calendar (GET /me/events).

tools.name: get_calendar_view
tools.description: Retrieves occurrences of events within a specific time window (GET /me/calendarView).

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Retrieves complete event metadata, location, attendees, and Teams meeting links (GET /me/events/{id}).

eventId.description: The unique Microsoft Graph ID of the event

tools.name: create_event
tools.description: Schedules a calendar event with attendees, agenda, and optional online Teams meeting (POST /me/events).

isOnlineMeeting.description: Whether to generate a Microsoft Teams online meeting link

tools.name: update_event
tools.description: Modifies timing, attendees, location, or agenda of an existing event (PATCH /me/events/{id}).

tools.name: delete_event
tools.description: Cancels a meeting and removes it from the calendar (DELETE /me/events/{id}).

eventId.description: The event ID to cancel / delete

tools.name: accept_event
tools.description: Formally accepts a calendar meeting invitation (POST /me/events/{id}/accept).

tools.name: decline_event
tools.description: Declines a calendar meeting invitation (POST /me/events/{id}/decline).

tools.name: tentatively_accept_event
tools.description: Tentatively accepts a calendar meeting invitation (POST /me/events/{id}/tentativelyAccept).

eventId.description: The event ID to tentatively accept

tools.name: find_meeting_times
tools.description: Checks free/busy availability of requested attendees and suggests optimal meeting slots (POST /me/findMeetingTimes).

meetingDurationMinutes.description: Duration of the proposed meeting in minutes (default: 30)

tools.name: list_contacts
tools.description: Lists contacts from the user personal address book (GET /me/contacts).

tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: Retrieves complete profile, emails, phones, and job title of a contact (GET /me/contacts/{id}).

tools.name: create_contact
tools.description: Adds a new person to the address book (POST /me/contacts).

tools.name: update_contact
tools.description: Updates information for an existing contact (PATCH /me/contacts/{id}).

tools.name: delete_contact
tools.description: Removes a contact from personal address book (DELETE /me/contacts/{id}).

tools.name: list_todo_lists
tools.description: Enumerates Microsoft To Do task lists and folders (GET /me/todo/lists).

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: Lists tasks within a specific To Do list (GET /me/todo/lists/{id}/tasks).

listId.description: The To Do list ID (or default list if omitted)

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Creates a new task in Microsoft To Do (POST /me/todo/lists/{id}/tasks).

listId.description: Optional list ID (uses default task list if omitted)

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Updates task title, completion status, or due date (PATCH /me/todo/lists/{id}/tasks/{taskId}).

listId.description: The list ID containing the task

tools.name: delete_task
tools.description: Permanently deletes a task from Microsoft To Do (DELETE /me/todo/lists/{id}/tasks/{taskId}).

listId.description: The list ID containing the task

tools.name: list_message_rules
tools.description: Lists automated inbox sorting, forwarding, and categorization rules (GET /me/mailFolders/inbox/messageRules).

tools.name: get_mailbox_settings
tools.description: Inspects user timezone, working hours, language, and automatic Out-of-Office (OOO) status (GET /me/mailboxSettings).

tools.name: create_message_rule
tools.description: Creates an automated server-side inbox rule for sorting, moving, or forwarding messages (POST /me/mailFolders/inbox/messageRules).

actions.description: Actions to perform (e.g. moveToFolder, markAsRead, assignCategories)

tools.name: delete_message_rule
tools.description: Permanently deletes an automated inbox rule (DELETE /me/mailFolders/inbox/messageRules/{id}).

tools.name: get_user_profile
tools.description: Retrieves authenticated user identity, primary mailbox email, display name, and tenant ID (GET /me).

tools.name: get_automatic_replies
tools.description: Inspects active Out-of-Office (OOO) automatic reply status, internal/external reply text, and schedule (GET /me/mailboxSettings/automaticRepliesSetting).

tools.name: set_automatic_replies
tools.description: Configures Out-of-Office (OOO) auto-replies, status (disabled, alwaysEnabled, scheduled), and messages (PATCH /me/mailboxSettings).

scheduledStartDateTime.description: Start time if status is scheduled

scheduledEndDateTime.description: End time if status is scheduled

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Lists all master color categories defined in the user Outlook account (GET /me/outlook/masterCategories).

basis.provider: Microsoft Graph API v1.0 / Official Outlook MCP Specification
